title: Design facility controls as coordinated layers: concept decisions 2
teachingQuestion: Which coordinated facility control set protects this asset, and what response makes it effective?
focalInsight: Facility safeguards need maintenance, monitoring, accountable response, and test evidence.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Physical Access Control
nodes.definition: Authorization, authentication, and recording of physical entry to protected areas.
nodes.detail: Authorization, authentication, and recording of physical entry to protected areas.
nodes.decision: Choose identity assurance, zones, escort, logging, review, emergency behavior, and anti-tailgating measures.
nodes.failureExample: A shared badge gives untraceable access to a server room.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Physical access needs attributable, purpose-limited entry.

nodes.label: Control Assessment
nodes.definition: Testing whether a facility control is designed, operating, and responsive as intended.
nodes.detail: Testing whether a facility control is designed, operating, and responsive as intended.
nodes.decision: Test normal, emergency, maintenance, alert, and recovery behavior with evidence.
nodes.failureExample: A control passes installation but fails when a responder is unavailable.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Assessment verifies operation and response, not presence alone.
